name: baskets
title: Baskets
summary: People turn a pasted list of markets into a composite market anyone can trade: lines resolve and price live, the same basket always maps to the same market, idle baskets archive themselves and come back when created again.

env.name: BASKETS_SYMBOL_PREFIX
env.doc: Symbol prefix of basket markets (1–11 of A–Z, 0–9): BKT-7KQ2M9.

env.name: BASKETS_MIN_VALUE
env.doc: Smallest basket value (Σ quantity × price, in the exchange's quote currency) that can be listed.

env.name: BASKETS_MIN_LINES
env.doc: Fewest different markets in a basket (1–100).

env.name: BASKETS_MAX_LINES
env.doc: Most different markets in a basket (BASKETS_MIN_LINES–100; the oracle prices up to 100 parts).

env.name: BASKETS_MAX_LEVERAGE
env.doc: Max leverage of a new basket market; about half (rounded up) when one line is over half the value.

env.name: BASKETS_MIN_ORDER
env.doc: Minimum order (notional) on a new basket market.

env.name: BASKETS_OI_CAP_MIN
env.doc: Smallest open interest cap of a new basket market (the cap is 100 × its value, clamped, halved when concentrated).

env.name: BASKETS_OI_CAP_MAX
env.doc: Largest open interest cap of a new basket market.

env.name: BASKETS_PER_DAY
env.doc: New baskets one person may list per 24 hours (joining an existing basket doesn't count).

env.name: BASKETS_PER_MONTH
env.doc: New baskets one person may list per 30 days.

env.name: BASKETS_CAPACITY
env.doc: Baskets that may be listed (not archived) at once; creating or reviving one past it is refused until others archive.

env.name: BASKETS_IDLE_DAYS
env.doc: A basket with no open positions and no trading by people for this many days is archived (its market halted, its page kept).

env.name: BASKETS_END_GRACE_DAYS
env.doc: Days after a basket's end date before it winds down: reduce-only while people hold positions, archived once they've closed.

env.name: BASKETS_REPORTS_TO_FLAG
env.doc: Open reports that take a basket out of discovery until staff review it (it still trades).

env.name: BASKETS_BLOCKED_TERMS
env.doc: Comma-separated words and phrases basket names and descriptions may not use (matched as whole words, case, accents and digit swaps ignored). Add the app's own name.

stitch: Stitch the exchange to the oracle first (exchange FEATURE.md → Stitching step 2): basket markets get their index price from their oracle basket feed through it; without it they trade only on development seed prices.
Decide what a line may name: the exchange's markets (default), or a larger reference catalog through baskets.SetResolver (FEATURE.md → Stitching shows the catalog feature plugged in).

Set the limits for your audience: BASKETS_MIN_VALUE, BASKETS_PER_DAY / BASKETS_PER_MONTH, BASKETS_CAPACITY, BASKETS_IDLE_DAYS, and the spec knobs (BASKETS_MAX_LEVERAGE, BASKETS_MIN_ORDER, BASKETS_OI_CAP_MIN / MAX) in the exchange's quote currency.

Names and descriptions are user content: fill BASKETS_BLOCKED_TERMS (include the app's own name); with the moderation feature installed, add baskets.SetTextCheck(moderation.Check) in an init(). Staff work reports in Admin → Baskets.

Basket markets appear on the exchange's Markets screen under the Baskets category; rename "Baskets" in web/src/features/baskets/registry.ts and mobile/src/features/baskets/registry.tsx if the product calls them something else.
